author: Krono I
title: PPO with CNN-LSTM Architecture
abstract: This submission implements Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) as an alternative to the baseline policy gradient algorithm. The hypothesis is that PPO's clipped objective will lead to more stable training and achieve a higher solve rate. It uses the same CNN-LSTM network architecture as the RNN baseline (ID 2) to isolate the impact of the algorithm change.
